courses.title: The Alchemy of Balance: Science and Soulful Strategies to Calm Stress
courses.description: A New Year retreat at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, joining breathwork, relaxation, movement and self-inquiry with what neuroscience says about stress and awe. Priti teaches her 7 Gateways to Whole-Life Balance and helps each guest shape simple daily rituals to carry home.

left_out: Yoga therapy sessions (https://lifeasyoga.com/pages/services, anchor #yogatherapy only): no page of its own (it shares the services page with the coaching item already listed, and a made-up fragment is not allowed), and the text offers to bring yoga into a client's 'healing protocol' for cancer patients and people with life-threatening illness, alongside their medical treatment: treatment of disease, still out under the new rule.
flags: The Alchemy of Balance: Kripalu's page says the retreat helps 'interrupt chronic stress patterns' and teaches 'how stress affects mood, sleep, immunity, and overall health'. That is stress education, not a claim to treat a disease, so kept under the new rule. Price on the page: 'Tuition: $399' plus minimum accommodation (weekday $109 / weekend $129 a night).
